Looklive is a fashion discovery and shopping platform that monetizes products that are already featured in a content. Looklive's online shopping platform that enables users to browse the style of celebrities and influencers, enabling them to get inspiration from their looks.

Looklive was founded in 2013 and is based in Atlanta, Georgia.
